scope: Bounded directly inspected handoffs; no cross-owner denominator or closure claim

consumers.meaning: Fresh batch chronology receives freshly obtained lower index; live path first updates live views and registers prepared lower/main indexes by exact sequence identity, then constructs new chronology with both. This is a bounded native constructor route, not proof of every subsequent mutation or exception.
A helper passes use_intrabar_start=False; this changes starting scan, not necessarily returned timestamp.

Canonical cached stop is eligible for ordinal and exact canonical reaction object; cache keyed by number on that route, alternative direct provider path bypasses this cache. Context-only stop not invented. Full lifetime and invalidation still pending B05.
Secondary stop adapter forwards ordinal/reaction/opposite list/start index to provider, does not independently create an Order.
Confirmation wrapper delegates default true, with supplied direction; no independent chronology re-selection here.

Bridge calls provider with supplied flag, obtains appropriate level in narrow exception guard, then validates returned exact timestamp in opposite stop direction. No alternative event chosen; native fallback can pass on actual equal-time evidence.

Shared prepared index path separately validates prepared.candles is candles before global registration. MarketChronology constructor itself lacks this guard. This partial B01 consumer boundary is confirmed without closing CP351-F03.
